Hi — I have a Fubini swap helper for two iterated intervalIntegrals under joint continuity of the integrand:
lemma intervalIntegral_swap_continuous{f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ}
(hf : Continuous (Function.uncurry f)) (a b c d : ℝ) :
(∫ y in c..d, ∫ x in a..b, f x y) = (∫ x in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, f x y)
It fills the gap between the existing integral_integral_swap (two full integrals) and intervalIntegral_integral_swap (one interval integral, one full integral).
Is anyone already working on this?
Suggested home Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/IntervalIntegral/Fubini.lean — is that the right place or do you prefer it elsewhere?
https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.07636 discusses Fubini for Bochner integrals. This is in Mathlib: docs##MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap
